title: The World Of The Unseen 5 Truths Of Revelation 3rd Reciprocal Response Through Speech

questions.question: What does “Divine condescension to the minds of men” mean in this passage?
questions.answer: It means speaking to people in a way they can understand.

questions.question: What does the passage say Allah gives to all conscious creatures?
questions.answer: Speech.

questions.question: In the second point, how does Allah first make Himself known in the world?
questions.answer: By His amazing creations and the signs in them.

questions.question: What else must happen since Allah makes Himself known through creation?
questions.answer: He also makes Himself known with His own words.

questions.question: Who are called the most chosen, needy, gentle, and eager among created beings?
questions.answer: Human beings.

questions.question: What do true people do that Allah answers in the third point?
questions.answer: They pray and thank Him.

questions.question: How does the third point show Allah’s care for people?
questions.answer: He answers their prayers and thanks with words.

questions.question: Which two qualities are tied to the attribute of Speech in the fourth point?
questions.answer: Knowledge and Life.

questions.question: What kind of Knowledge and Life does the passage describe for Allah?
questions.answer: Perfect Knowledge and everlasting Life.

questions.question: If Allah’s Knowledge is complete and His Life is eternal, what does the passage say about His Speech?
questions.answer: His Speech must also be full and eternal.

questions.question: How many main points are in the target passage?
questions.answer: Four.

questions.question: What is the first main point mostly about?
questions.answer: Allah speaks to people in a way their minds can understand.

questions.question: What does the first point teach about Allah and His creatures’ speech?
questions.answer: He gives them speech, knows what they say, and speaks to them.

questions.question: What is the second main point mostly about?
questions.answer: The One who shows His greatness in creation also speaks with His own words.

questions.question: What in the universe points to Allah’s greatness in the second point?
questions.answer: His wonderful created things.

questions.question: What is the third main point mostly about?
questions.answer: Allah answers the prayers and thanks of people.

questions.question: Which people are highlighted in the third point?
questions.answer: The best and most needy human beings.

questions.question: What is the fourth main point mostly about?
questions.answer: Speech belongs with Knowledge and Life.

questions.question: If someone has complete knowledge and endless life, what does the passage say must also be true?
questions.answer: Speech must be found in a full and everlasting way.

questions.question: Which point talks most clearly about prayer?
questions.answer: The third point.

questions.question: Which point talks most clearly about speaking at a level people can understand?
questions.answer: The first point.

questions.question: What is one reason Allah speaks to people according to the first point?
questions.answer: So people can understand His message.

questions.question: What shows Allah’s greatness before the passage mentions His words in the second point?
questions.answer: The amazing things He created.

questions.question: If Allah fills the world with signs about Himself, what is a natural next step?
questions.answer: He also tells about Himself with speech.

questions.question: In the third point, what two things from people are mentioned together?
questions.answer: Their prayers and their thanks.

questions.question: What does the third point teach about Allah’s response?
questions.answer: He responds with words.

questions.question: In the fourth point, Speech is connected to which two living qualities?
questions.answer: Knowledge and Life.

questions.question: What word in the fourth point shows Allah’s Life never ends?
questions.answer: Eternal.

questions.question: What big idea do all four points support together?
questions.answer: Allah speaks and communicates with His creatures.

questions.question: After giving creatures speech, what two more actions are mentioned?
questions.answer: He understands them and speaks to them.

questions.question: In the second point, what are the created things like?
questions.answer: They are signs that show Allah’s greatness and perfection.

questions.question: If created things tell about Allah, what does the passage say Allah will also do?
questions.answer: He will speak with His own words.

questions.question: In the third point, what are people offering to Allah besides prayers?
questions.answer: Thanks.

questions.question: What does the third point say is part of Allah being the Creator?
questions.answer: Answering people with words.

questions.question: In the fourth point, what kind of Speech is mentioned for Allah?
questions.answer: Speech that is complete and everlasting.

questions.question: What makes this complete and everlasting Speech fitting for Allah?
questions.answer: His complete Knowledge and eternal Life.

questions.question: Which point is most about Allah helping people understand?
questions.answer: The first point.

questions.question: Which point is most about Allah’s perfect qualities?
questions.answer: The fourth point.

questions.question: What does the first point say about the way Allah speaks to people?
questions.answer: He speaks in a way suited to their minds.

questions.question: What special gift to conscious creatures is named in the first point?
questions.answer: The gift of speech.

questions.question: What does Allah do with the speech of His creatures?
questions.answer: He knows it and answers it.

questions.question: According to the second point, what fills the universe?
questions.answer: Allah’s wonderful works.

questions.question: What do these wonderful works show about Allah?
questions.answer: They show His greatness and beautiful qualities.

questions.question: Since Allah shows Himself through creation, what else does the passage say He does?
questions.answer: He also speaks with His own words.

questions.question: Who is praying and thanking Allah in the third point?
questions.answer: Human beings, especially the best and most needy ones.

questions.question: What does the third point teach us about Allah and du‘a?
questions.answer: He answers it with words.

questions.question: In the fourth point, Speech is said to go together with which two attributes?
questions.answer: Knowledge and Life.

questions.question: What is the simple meaning of the first point?
questions.answer: Allah talks to people in ways they can understand.

questions.question: What three things does the first point say about Allah and speech?
questions.answer: He gives speech, knows speech, and speaks.

questions.question: What do the created things do in the second point?
questions.answer: They show Allah’s greatness and make Him known.

questions.question: What follows after that in the second point?
questions.answer: Allah makes Himself known with His own words too.

questions.question: In the third point, what are people doing toward Allah?
questions.answer: They are asking Him and thanking Him.

questions.question: What kind of people are especially named there?
questions.answer: Very chosen, needy, and eager human beings.

questions.question: What does Allah do for them according to the third point?
questions.answer: He answers them in words.

questions.question: If Allah’s Knowledge covers everything and His Life never ends, what does the fourth point say about His Speech?
questions.answer: It must be complete and everlasting too.
